name: 29575 · Surfside Bch, SC
findings: ZIP 29575 (Surfside Bch) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29575 (Surfside Bch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29575 (Surfside Bch) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 25% of the typical level).
